rule_hit_review.why: The ad's SPF is 50, matching the page label; the 56.6 in the footnote is the independent ISO 24444:2019 test result from the page, presented as lab data.

language_read: SPF 50 matches the label and the instructions follow the page. No waterproof, sunblock or complete-protection wording.
